title: Score predictions against what the done later did, and report it
description:
The property that makes gvc self-correcting, and it is free: a prediction made while an acceptance item was unrunnable becomes CHECKABLE the moment that item becomes runnable. What the classifier said, and what the done actually did, is a labelled pair.

That is a calibration set the factory generates BY OPERATING. It is the thing wne's 49-tick measurement could not have - that sample could only test face validity, because every tick ran at its role's base model and no capability boundary was ever exercised. Here the ground truth arrives on its own, as a consequence of the epic finishing.

So: when an item that was predicted becomes runnable, run it and score the prediction. Record both. A prediction that was wrong is not a failure to hide - it is the only evidence anyone will ever have for where the threshold belongs, and gvc deliberately set that threshold by argument rather than measurement.

AND THE RETRO REPORTS IT. The close-out must be able to say, for this epic: what was absorbed, against which acceptance item, whether the verdict was observed or predicted, and for each prediction later checked, whether it was right. An epic that absorbed silently is an epic whose shape changed with no account of why.
